summary.text: Chris Metcalfe is the Republican candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 85 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Dagmara Avelar (D).
Metcalfe is a project manager and former chemical engineer from Bolingbrook.

paragraphs.text: Metcalfe was born in Covina, California, and earned bachelor's degrees from Southern Oregon State University in 1978 and Lamar University in 1986.
Ballotpedia says he has worked as a project manager, chemical engineer, operations manager and paramedic, and in underwater rescue and recovery for a sheriff's department.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he designed and built chemical plants for large companies and lives in Bolingbrook with his wife, Karen, whose tax and accounting business he helps run.
Metcalfe lost the District 85 general election to Avelar in 2022 and again in 2024.
He won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary.
